meta.case: 17 Sep 2026 about 18:00 local, Porto Batel and Consolação
meta.viewer_note: Assumed: the swell bends round Peniche and reaches the edge of the lidar strip head-on at full offshore height (an upper bound). Taken as it is, a 337 deg swell runs along this coast and the simple model cannot bring it in.
meta.order: same order and count as reefs.json

fields.broken: 1 = broken (height held at gamma x depth)
fields.phase: phase (rad): k summed along the shoreward march (crests follow the 100 m smoothed shore line), wrapped to 0..2pi
fields.state: 0 dry or in the lee of dry land, 1 unbroken, 2 broken, 3 not reachable (wave runs along/away from coast)

assumptions: linear waves, one height and one period for the whole sea
offshore height treated as deep-water height; no losses before the lidar edge
refraction by Snell's law for straight contours parallel to the local (100 m smoothed) shore
no sheltering by the Peniche headland, no bathymetry outside the ~600 m lidar strip
breaking when H >= gamma x depth; inside the surf zone H is held at gamma x depth; reform when the water deepens
it does not simulate the shape of a breaking wave
